title: Cross-modal Clinical Graph Transformer for Ophthalmic Report Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Compressing visual features into a single token and combining them with a clinical sub-graph to prevent the model from disproportionately focusing on normal tissues (which dominate the image) rather than smaller abnormal regions.

Applying a visible matrix during the cross-modal encoding process to limit the impact of unrelated triples and prevent the model from defaulting to highly frequent, repetitive sentences found in the training corpus.
